entries.note: The parcel's data, before the origin warehouse has it.
Runner Express's own warehouse at the origin, in Shenzhen for the sample, receives the parcel.

entries.wording: The shenzhen warehouse has been sent out
entries.note: The parcel leaves the origin warehouse for the flight.
A wait for space on a flight: the parcel moves on with the next one.
The flight lands in Israel. The misspelling is the carrier's.

entries.wording: Held at Clearance Facility – Declaration submitted
entries.note: The import declaration is filed and the parcel waits for clearance.
The truck from the airport's clearance facility takes the parcel.
The parcel waits for the recipient at a pickup point.
Repeated every few days while the parcel waits at the pickup point.

entries.wording: enReady to back to Sorting Center
entries.note: The first step of the return from an uncollected pickup point. The leading "en" is the carrier's.

entries.wording: On the way back to Sorting Center
entries.note: The return leg from the pickup point.
The returned parcel is back at the sorting center.
The parcel is set to go back to the shipper.
